transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have an opportunity to run an overnight production run of heat-treated brackets in Furnace 4. Let's start with workforce planning — do we have two qualified operators available for an overnight shift?

transcript.text: I completed my permit review today after this week's argon-cylinder replacement on Furnace 4. There are two critical EHS requirements for the overnight run: first, continuous oxygen monitoring must be in place during the entire run with the alarm set exactly at 19.5% oxygen.
